artifacts.notes: Complete Wilson 1915 volume, 432 PDF pages; printed pp. xvii–xviii (PDF pp. 27–28), xliv–xlv (PDF pp. 54–55), and 173–174 (PDF pp. 231–232) visually inspected. Title/imprint identified in the complete embedded text at PDF pp. 7 and 9. The source text is Latin; Wilson’s English introduction is editorial matter, not an English translation of the sacramentary. No English translation receipt was supplied.
artifacts.rights_basis: The identified 1915 printing is public domain in the United States by publication date. The exact artifact is a mechanical facsimile or uncorrected OCR of that printing; digitizer identification adds factual provenance, not a new edition of the work.

edition.title: The Gregorian Sacramentary under Charles the Great, edited from three MSS. of the ninth century by H. A. Wilson

work.author: Catholic Church
work.description: The papal sacramentary sent by Hadrian I to Charlemagne, transmitted with the supplement long ascribed to Alcuin. It is the immediate ancestor of the medieval and Tridentine Roman Mass books and the second great reservoir the twentieth-century reform drew its orations from.
work.title: Sacramentarium Gregorianum (Hadrianum)
